# casdoor_application (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor application, the OAuth 2.0 / OIDC / SAML client that users sign in to.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_application" "portal" {
  name          = "app-acme-portal"
  organization  = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  display_name  = "Acme Portal"
  cert          = casdoor_cert.acme.name
  redirect_uris = ["https://portal.acme.example.com/callback"]
  grant_types   = ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"]

  enable_password = true
  enable_sign_up  = true

  providers = [
    {
      name        = casdoor_provider.github.name
      owner       = "admin"
      can_sign_in = true
      can_sign_up = true
      rule        = "None"
    },
  ]
}

output "portal_client_id" {
  value = casdoor_application.portal.client_id
}

output "portal_client_secret" {
  value     = casdoor_application.portal.client_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the application, unique within its owner.
- `organization` (String) The organization whose users sign in to the application.

### Optional

- `affiliation_url` (String) The affiliation URL.
- `backchannel_logout_uri` (String) The OIDC back-channel logout URI that is notified when a user signs out.
- `category` (String) The category, e.g. `Default` or `Agent`.
- `cert` (String) The name of the cert that signs the tokens.
- `client_cert` (String) The name of the cert that verifies the client.
- `client_id` (String) The client ID. Generated by Casdoor when not set.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The client secret. Generated by Casdoor when not set.
- `code_resend_timeout` (Number) The number of seconds before a verification code can be sent again, 0 means the default.
- `cookie_expire_in_hours` (Number) The lifetime of the sign-in session cookie, in hours.
- `default_group` (String) The group that new users are added to at sign-up.
- `default_tag` (String) The tag that new users get at sign-up.
- `description` (String) The description.
- `disable_refresh_rotation` (Boolean) Whether the refresh token stays the same when it is used, instead of being replaced.
- `disable_saml_attributes` (Boolean) Whether the user attributes are left out of the SAML response.
- `disable_self_signup` (Boolean) Whether users are kept from signing up by themselves.
- `disable_signin` (Boolean) Whether signing in to the application is disabled.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `enable_auto_signin` (Boolean) Whether users with a valid session are signed in automatically.
- `enable_code_signin` (Boolean) Whether users can sign in with a verification code.
- `enable_exclusive_signin` (Boolean) Whether a new sign-in signs the user out of the other sessions.
- `enable_guest_signin` (Boolean) Whether users can sign in as a guest.
- `enable_link_with_email` (Boolean) Whether a third-party account is linked to the user with the same email.
- `enable_password` (Boolean) Whether users can sign in with a password.
- `enable_saml_assertion_signature` (Boolean) Whether the SAML assertion is signed.
- `enable_saml_c14n10` (Boolean) Whether the SAML response is canonicalized with exclusive C14N 1.0.
- `enable_saml_compress` (Boolean) Whether the SAML response is compressed.
- `enable_saml_post_binding` (Boolean) Whether the SAML response is sent with the HTTP POST binding.
- `enable_sign_up` (Boolean) Whether users can sign up.
- `enable_signin_session` (Boolean) Whether the sign-in session is kept in a cookie.
- `enable_web_authn` (Boolean) Whether users can sign in with WebAuthn.
- `expire_in_hours` (Number) The lifetime of the access token, in hours.
- `failed_signin_frozen_time` (Number) The number of minutes a user stays frozen after reaching the limit, 0 means the default of 15.
- `failed_signin_limit` (Number) The number of failed sign-in attempts after which the user is frozen, 0 means the default of 5.
- `favicon` (String) The favicon URL.
- `footer_html` (String) The HTML of the footer.
- `forced_redirect_origin` (String) The origin that the sign-in pages of the application are always served from.
- `forget_url` (String) A custom forgot-password page URL.
- `form_background_url` (String) The background image URL of the sign-in pages.
- `form_background_url_mobile` (String) The background image URL of the sign-in pages on mobile devices.
- `form_css` (String) The CSS of the sign-in form.
- `form_css_mobile` (String) The CSS of the sign-in form on mobile devices.
- `form_offset` (Number) The position of the sign-in form: 1 for left, 2 for center, 3 for right, 4 for center with the side panel.
- `form_side_html` (String) The HTML of the side panel.
- `grant_types` (List of String) The allowed OAuth grant types, e.g. `authorization_code`, `password`, `client_credentials`, `token`, `refresh_token`.
- `header_html` (String) The HTML added to the head of the sign-in pages.
- `homepage_url` (String) The homepage URL.
- `ip_whitelist` (String) The IP addresses or CIDRs allowed to sign in, separated by commas.
- `is_shared` (Boolean) Whether the application, which must belong to the `built-in` organization, is shared with all organizations.
- `logo` (String) The logo URL.
- `logo_dark` (String) The logo URL for the dark theme.
- `max_sessions` (Number) The maximum number of concurrent sessions of a user in the application.
- `order` (Number) The position of the application in lists.
- `org_choice_mode` (String) How the organization is chosen on the sign-in page: empty, `None`, `Select` or `Input`.
- `providers` (Attributes List) The providers used by the application, e.g. identity providers for social sign-in, and email, SMS or captcha providers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) The allowed redirect URIs, which can be regular expressions.
- `refresh_expire_in_hours` (Number) The lifetime of the refresh token, in hours.
- `saml_attributes` (Attributes List) The custom attributes added to the SAML response. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saml_attributes))
- `saml_c14n_prefix` (String) The namespace prefix list used with `enable_saml_c14n10`.
- `saml_hash_algorithm` (String) The hash algorithm of the SAML signature: `SHA1`, `SHA256` or `SHA512`.
- `saml_reply_url` (String) The assertion consumer service URL of the SAML service provider.
- `saml_single_logout_url` (String) The single logout URL of the SAML service provider.
- `signin_html` (String) The HTML shown on the sign-in page.
- `signin_methods` (Attributes List) The sign-in methods shown on the sign-in page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--signin_methods))
- `signin_url` (String) A custom sign-in page URL.
- `signup_html` (String) The HTML shown on the sign-up page.
- `signup_url` (String) A custom sign-up page URL.
- `tags` (List of String) The tags.
- `terms_of_use` (String) The URL of the terms of use.
- `title` (String) The title of the sign-in pages.
- `token_attributes` (Attributes List) The custom claims added to a `JWT-Custom` token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--token_attributes))
- `token_fields` (List of String) The user fields included in a `JWT-Custom` token.
- `token_format` (String) The format of the access token, e.g. `JWT`, `JWT-Empty`, `JWT-Custom` or `JWT-Standard`.
- `token_group_format` (String) How groups appear in the token: empty for `organization/group`, `Name` for group names or `Path` for full group paths.
- `token_signing_method` (String) The algorithm that signs the tokens: `RS256`, `RS512`, `ES256`, `ES384` or `ES512`.
- `type` (String) The type, e.g. `All`, `OIDC`, `OAuth`, `SAML` or `CAS`.
- `use_email_as_saml_name_id` (Boolean) Whether the email is used as the SAML NameID.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the application was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the application in the `owner/name` format.

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the provider.

Optional:

- `can_sign_in` (Boolean) Whether users can sign in with the provider.
- `can_sign_up` (Boolean) Whether users can sign up with the provider.
- `can_unlink` (Boolean) Whether users can unlink the provider from their account.
- `owner` (String) The owner of the provider.
- `prompted` (Boolean) Whether users are prompted to link the provider.
- `rule` (String) The rule, e.g. `None`, `Dynamic`, `Always` or `All` depending on the provider category.


<a id="nestedatt--saml_attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saml_attributes`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the attribute.

Optional:

- `name_format` (String) The name format of the attribute.
- `value` (String) The value of the attribute.


<a id="nestedatt--signin_methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `signin_methods`

Required:

- `name` (String) The sign-in method, e.g. `Password`, `Verification code` or `WebAuthn`.

Optional:

- `display_name` (String) The label of the method.
- `rule` (String) The rule of the method, e.g. `All`.


<a id="nestedatt--token_attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `token_attributes`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the claim.

Optional:

- `category` (String) Where the value comes from: `Static Value` or `Existing Field`.
- `type` (String) The type of the claim, e.g. `String` or `Array`.
- `value` (String) The value, or the user field that the value is read from.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Organizations and applications are imported by name.
terraform import casdoor_application.example <name>
```
